title: Cendol: Open Instruction-tuned Generative Large Language Models for Indonesian Languages
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the generation of toxic content related to specific religious groups (Jewish and Muslim) using the ToxiGen dataset translated into Indonesian. This was part of a broader safety evaluation.
models_tested: Cendol mT5 (small, base, large, XL, XXL)
findings: The study found that safety measures incorporated during the pre-training of foundation models like LLaMA-2 (which is English-centric) are transferable to fine-tuned models for low-resource languages like Indonesian. Specifically, the LLaMA2-based Cendol models generated significantly less toxic and hateful content related to various demographic groups, including Jewish and Muslim communities, compared to models based on mT5 which lacks such safety pre-training.
